## searchSimilarTicketsForConversation

Search Similar Tickets For Conversation. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/search-similar-tickets`

Retired. Always returns 410 Gone.

Similar ticket search was retired in October 2026 (conversation summaries are no longer indexed for search). Summaries are still stored on each conversation; list them with GET /api/v1/knowledge-base/tickets.

```php
$sendseven->agentSuggestions()->searchSimilarTicketsForConversation(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

## get

Get Agent Suggestions. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/suggest`

Get AI-powered suggestions for agent based on conversation context.

Searches the knowledge base using recent messages as context and returns relevant suggestions from FAQs, manuals, and past tickets.

```php
$result = $sendseven->agentSuggestions()->get(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

Returns `AgentSuggestion`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Agent%20Suggestions/get_agent_suggestions_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__suggest_post)
